title: Postprandial Lipid Metabolism in Patients With Hypertriglyceridemia and Normo-lipidemic Controls: Medium Chain Fatty Acids (MCT) in Comparison to Long-chain, Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA) and Mono-unsaturated Fatty Acids (MUFA)
brief_summary: Postprandial lipid metabolism will be evaluated in patients with hypertriglyceridemia and normo-lipidemic controls; different fats will be used (saturated fatty acids, mon-unsaturated fatty acids and medium chain fatty acids) for the oral fat challenge.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* hypertriglyceridemia (150 mg/dl-900 mg/dl)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lipid lowering drugs or indication for Lipid lowering drugs
* LDL-cholesterol \> 190 mg/dl
* Diabetes mellitus
